**Clarifying project details**

I have a budget of 26k and I've generated around 8k. I need to simplify the friction while keeping certain elements preserved. The file must include all names with every element and attribute listed on a single line. I haven’t tested claims yet. Additionally, I need to check the first geometry of the seesaw post beam when moving the post. Now, I’m considering the axle visual intersection and if the original axle geometries are static with the post, focusing on floor contact.
